gateway_config_run:
# Private-cache gate (CoSAI 3.2.7): agentgateway in front of the per-user
# practice upstream. RFC 8693 token exchange per user (no actor), inbound users
# validated by jwtAuth. No caching knob is set: agentgateway 1.7.0 has no MCP
# result cache to configure (only backendAuth token-exchange response caching).
#
# This file is a TEMPLATE: cachescope_gateway_gate.py replaces every port below
# (4330 gateway, 4331 admin, 4390 AS, 4380 upstream) from its env and runs the
# copy from a scratch dir (agentgateway writes a session key into the file it
# is given). Loopback only: agentgateway binds all interfaces by default, so
# every listener is pinned to 127.0.0.1 and stats/readiness are off.
config:
  adminAddr: 127.0.0.1:4331
  statsAddr: "off"
  readinessAddr: "off"
gateways:
  cachescope:
    port: 4330
    bindAddress: 127.0.0.1
routes:
- name: cachescope-mcp
  gateways: cachescope
  policies:
    jwtAuth:
      mode: strict
      providers:
      - issuer: https://local-as.test
        audiences: [agentgateway-api]
        jwks:
          url: http://127.0.0.1:4390/jwks
  backends:
  - mcp:
      statefulMode: stateful
      targets:
      - name: upstream
        mcp:
          host: http://127.0.0.1:4380/mcp
        policies:
          backendAuth:
            oauthTokenExchange:
              host: 127.0.0.1:4390
              path: /token
              subjectToken:
                source:
                  expression: jwt.rawToken.unredacted()
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              audiences: [https://upstream.test/mcp]
              scopes: [read:notes]
client_transport: HTTPTransport(modern=True): MCP-Protocol-Version 2026-07-28 header + _meta envelope, no initialize
inbound_auth: jwtAuth strict, issuer local-as.test, audience agentgateway-api

protocol_versions.client_to_gateway_note: HTTPTransport(modern=True): MCP-Protocol-Version 2026-07-28 header + _meta envelope, no initialize

grade_labelling_subject: origin (practice upstream, cacheScope set by the operator)

upstream_config.content_key: verified JWT (orig_iss|iss, sub); never the raw token

labelling.detail: origin returns different content to A and B for the same request but labels it cacheScope=public

honouring.detail: origin label is public, not private: sharing is permitted or unspecified; see the labelling verdict

broken_leaky_proxy_private.honouring_detail: B received A's private content for the identical request
broken_leaky_proxy_private.labelling_detail: content differs per identity and is labelled private

safe_proxy_private.honouring_detail: caching observed, and B received B's own content, not A's
safe_proxy_private.labelling_detail: content differs per identity and is labelled private

label_public_mislabel.honouring_detail: origin label is public, not private: sharing is permitted or unspecified; see the labelling verdict
label_public_mislabel.labelling_detail: origin returns different content to A and B for the same request but labels it cacheScope=public

label_private.honouring_detail: caching observed, and B received B's own content, not A's
label_private.labelling_detail: content differs per identity and is labelled private

tokens: never stored; content keyed on verified identity, not the token
